summary: Scanned osv-demo (requirements.txt, 1 pinned package) with osv-scanner 2.7.1 against api.osv.dev. requests 2.25.0 matches four advisory groups: a Proxy-Authorization leak, a .netrc credentials leak, TLS verification left off after verify=False, and an insecure temp-file reuse. All fixed by upgrading to requests 2.33.0.

tools_run.name: osv-scanner
tools_run.command: osv-scanner scan source -r --data-source native --no-resolve --format json --output-file evidence/artifacts/osv.json .

tools_run.name: osv-scanner
tools_run.command: osv-scanner scan source -r --data-source native --no-resolve --format sarif --output-file evidence/artifacts/osv.sarif .

findings.title: requests 2.25.0 leaks Proxy-Authorization headers (GHSA-j8r2-6x86-q33q)
findings.description: requests 2.25.0 is vulnerable to CVE-2023-32681 (alias PYSEC-2023-74). During HTTPS requests sent over an HTTP proxy, the Proxy-Authorization header can leak to the destination server on redirect, exposing proxy credentials. Affected from 2.3.0, fixed in 2.31.0.

findings.title: requests 2.25.0 leaks .netrc credentials via malicious URLs (GHSA-9hjg-9r4m-mvj7)
findings.description: requests 2.25.0 is vulnerable to CVE-2024-47081 (alias PYSEC-2026-1872). A URL parsing issue can leak .netrc credentials to third parties when requests follows a maliciously crafted URL. Fixed in 2.32.4.

findings.title: requests Session keeps TLS verification off after a first request with verify=False (GHSA-9wx4-h78v-vm56)
findings.description: requests 2.25.0 is vulnerable to CVE-2024-35195 (alias PYSEC-2026-1873). If the first request to an origin on a Session uses verify=False, certificate verification can stay disabled for later requests to that origin even when verify=True is set. Fixed in 2.32.0.

findings.title: requests extract_zipped_paths() reuses a predictable temp file (GHSA-gc5v-m9x4-r6x2)
findings.description: requests 2.25.0 is vulnerable to CVE-2026-25645 (alias PYSEC-2026-2275). The requests.utils.extract_zipped_paths() utility extracts zip archives to a predictable filename, which a local actor can pre-create to tamper with the extracted content. Fixed in 2.33.0.
